subject: SIG artifacts: acceptance criteria and secure transfer
messages:
From: Tom Aldridge <tom.aldridge@healthcloud.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@healthcloud.com
Date: Fri, 10 Dec 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SIG + artifact delivery: what do you have available?

Illa / team —

Thanks again for walking through the SIG this morning. Our procurement and InfoSec teams are narrowing the list of required artifacts before the final legal review. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following and a rough ETA?

- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted OK)
- Executive summary of most recent pen test + remediation status
- ISO27001 scope/statement (signed)
- Customer-facing security slide deck (redacted)

Also: our security team needs the acceptance criteria for each artifact (what level of redaction is acceptable, whether PDFs need a signature page, file naming convention) and the preferred secure transfer method (SFTP, DocuSign secure upload, or shared Drive with limited access).

If you can share a short checklist today it would help speed approval on our side.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Aldridge
Head of Procurement — HealthCloud

From: irene.choi@redwood.com
To: Tom Aldridge <tom.aldridge@healthcloud.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG + artifact delivery: what do you have available?

Tom —

Great to meet earlier. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide all four artifacts. I'm copying Karthik (compliance lead) and Vanessa (security ops) to confirm delivery format and timing. Below is a preliminary acceptance checklist so your reviewers can start triaging against it: 

- SOC 2 Type II (redacted): PDF, remove customer-identifying attachments, include auditor signature page, filename: SOC2-Redwood-2027-TypeII-redacted.pdf
- Pen test summary: PDF one-pager + remediation log (spreadsheet). Redaction: no IP-exposing exploit PoCs, include CVSS severities and remediation status. Filename: pen-test-summary-2027.pdf / pen-test-remediation-2027.xlsx
- ISO statement: Word doc with scope and cert ID (if available). Signed/printed signature page preferred. Filename: ISO27001-statement-2027.docx
- Security deck: PDF, redacted for customer-specific references. Include slide with control mappings to SOC2/ISO. Filename: security-deck-redacted.pdf

Preferred transfer options (in order):
1) DocuSign Secure Upload (for signed artifacts)
2) Google Drive folder with view+download access limited to named contacts and a 7-day expiry
3) SFTP (we can provision an account, but DocuSign/Drive preferred for audit trail)

Karthik / Vanessa — can you confirm we can have the redacted SOC2 + pen test summary ready by EOD Monday (Dec 13)? If so we'll initiate DocuSign upload and send you the link for HealthCloud to access.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, Tom Aldridge <tom.aldridge@healthcloud.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG + artifact delivery: what do you have available?

Thanks, Irene / Tom —

Confirming we can deliver the redacted SOC 2 and pen-test summary by end of day Monday (Dec 13). A couple of notes on acceptance criteria from our side so HealthCloud's reviewers know what to expect: 

- SOC2: redaction will remove non-customer-specific system identifiers, customer lists, and raw logs. Auditor signature and report date will remain visible. We will append a one-paragraph attestation describing the redaction process.
- Pen test summary: includes executive summary, top 10 findings, CVSS and remediation status. Raw exploit code and internal ticket IDs removed. We will include a remediation log showing ticket references (internal IDs redacted) and current closure status.

We will initiate a DocuSign Secure Upload envelope for the signed artifacts and also place redacted copies in a restricted Google Drive folder for your convenience. DocuSign will provide an audit trail which usually satisfies procurement.

Tom — if HealthCloud requires SFTP instead, please flag in reply and we'll provision a short-lived account.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Compliance — Redwood Inference

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: Tom Aldridge <tom.aldridge@healthcloud.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 09:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG + artifact delivery: what do you have available?

Tom —

Uploading plan and links: 

- DocuSign secure upload envelope created: https://www.docusign.com/en/signer/ABC123-Transfer (DocuSign link expires in 14 days). Please use the envelope to upload any signed artifacts back to us (we will then reciprocate with our artifacts).
- Drive folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSIGEvidence — access granted to tom.aldridge@healthcloud.com and compliance@healthcloud.com. Files to appear by EOD today (SOC2 & pen-test summary redacted + security deck).

Attachments included in the upload to drive (redacted copies):
- SOC2-TypeII-2027-redacted.pdf (attestation appended)
- pen-test-summary-2027.pdf
- pen-test-remediation-2027.xlsx (redacted internal ids)
- ISO27001-statement-2027.docx
- security-deck-redacted.pdf

Acceptance checklist (short):
1) Signed auditor page present for SOC2 (required)
2) Pen test contains executive summary + remediation log (CSV/XLSX)
3) ISO statement contains scope & signature (scanned OK)
4) Deck redactions remove customer names and sample data

If HealthCloud security needs any of the originals under NDA we can provide a limited SFTP window after an executed NDA/BAA.

Thanks — Irena / Karthik, assigning follow-up to confirm Drive permissions once HealthCloud confirms receipt.

-Vanessa Ortiz
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-2027-redacted.pdf (PDF), pen-test-summary-2027.pdf (PDF), security-deck-redacted.pdf (PDF)

From: Tom Aldridge <tom.aldridge@healthcloud.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG + artifact delivery: what do you have available?

Vanessa / team —

Received the Drive invitation and was able to download the files. Quick confirmation from our InfoSec:

- SOC2: redaction acceptable; attestation paragraph present — approved
- Pen test: executive summary okay, would you add a brief column in the remediation log indicating "verification date" for closed items? Otherwise approved
- ISO statement: approved
- Deck: approved after removing a single slide with a customer name (already flagged)

Can you add the verification date column to the remediation spreadsheet by EOD Thursday (Dec 16)? If you can, we'll move to final legal review and drop the last blocker for the SIG.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tom
footer_notes: This thread is stored in the inbox folder for irene.choi@redwood.com. DocuSign and Drive links are provided above; attachments referenced are redacted copies suitable for procurement review. Internal IDs and any sensitive exploit details were removed prior to upload.
